repeated.instructions: Does the visitor describe a task that people at their organisation do by hand, again and again?

criteria.true: A recurring piece of manual work: copying, checking, compiling, chasing, entering, sending or booking something on a regular basis.
criteria.false: Not recurring manual work: a one-off project, a question, a complaint, a sales pitch, a greeting, nonsense, or something unrelated to work.

job.instructions: Which kind of repeated job does the visitor describe?

criteria.report: Building or updating a report, dashboard or set of figures from several sources.
criteria.new_client: Setting up a new client, customer, supplier or employee across several systems.
criteria.invoices: Invoices, payments, bills, expenses, cash flow or reconciling the bank.
criteria.copying: Typing or copying the same data from one system, form or document into another.
criteria.scheduling: Scheduling people, rotas, appointments, bookings, deliveries or rooms.
criteria.approvals: Getting sign-off or approval: requests, purchase orders, holidays, documents.
criteria.chasing: Chasing people for replies, documents, updates, timesheets or late payments.
criteria.other: Repeated work that fits none of the other kinds.

frequency.instructions: How often is the job done?
criteria: Every day or several times a day

people.instructions: Who does the job, going by the words in the sentence?

criteria.one: One person. For example: "I", "someone", "our office manager", "the coordinator", "finance".
criteria.few: Two or three people. For example: "two of us", "three people".
criteria.team: A team or a group of people. For example: "the finance team", "project managers", "staff", "the sales team".
criteria.unknown: The sentence gives no clue at all about who does it.

sys_spreadsheet.instructions: Does the job involve spreadsheets (for example Excel or Google Sheets)?

sys_email.instructions: Does the job involve email or an inbox?

sys_accounts.instructions: Does the job involve an accounting or finance system (for example Xero, Sage or QuickBooks)?

criteria.true: An accounts or finance system is used or mentioned.

sys_crm.instructions: Does the job involve a customer database or CRM (for example Salesforce or HubSpot)?

criteria.true: A CRM or customer database is used or mentioned.

sys_bank.instructions: Does the job involve a bank account or bank statements?

criteria.true: The bank is used or mentioned.

sys_paper.instructions: Does the job involve paper, PDFs or scanned documents?

criteria.true: Paper, PDFs or scans are used or mentioned.
criteria.false: No paper or PDFs are involved.

sys_portal.instructions: Does the job involve a website, supplier portal or online system that someone logs into?

criteria.true: A website or portal is used or mentioned.
criteria.false: No website or portal is involved.
